title: Protein Autoregressive Modeling via Multiscale Structure Generation

target_claims.claim: PAR is a multi-scale autoregressive framework for protein backbone generation that performs coarse-to-fine next-scale prediction (Figure 1).
target_claims.observation: Multiscale downsampling produced scale sizes [25, 50, 100] matching expected 4x, 2x, 1x coarse-to-fine resolutions.

target_claims.claim: PAR combines multi-scale downsampling, an autoregressive transformer for conditional embeddings, and a flow-based backbone decoder (Figure 1).
target_claims.observation: Transformer embeddings generated shape (50, 64) and flow decoder output shape (50, 3) with zero NaN values.

target_claims.claim: PAR addresses autoregressive exposure bias with noisy context learning and scheduled sampling (Section 3).
target_claims.observation: Noisy context injection perturbed embeddings by std 0.1 and scheduled sampling decayed teacher forcing prob from 1.00 to 0.10.
